# Torqvoice Corporate Contributor License Agreement

Version 1.0, 30 October 2026

This Agreement documents the rights a company or other legal entity grants to Torqvoice, represented by Bernt Christian Egeland ("Torqvoice"), for Contributions made by the persons it designates in Schedule A. Use it when the Corporation, not the individual author, owns the Contribution (an employee contributing at work, a consultancy building for a client). Each designated person also accepts the [Individual CLA](CLA.md) on their first pull request. Adapted from the Apache Software Foundation Corporate Contributor License Agreement, version r190612.

## 1. Definitions

**"You"** (or **"Your"**) means the copyright owner or legal entity authorized by the copyright owner that is entering into this Agreement with Torqvoice (the "Corporation"). For legal entities, the entity making a Contribution and all other entities that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with that entity are considered to be a single Contributor. For the purposes of this definition, "control" means (i) the power, direct or indirect, to cause the direction or management of such entity, whether by contract or otherwise, or (ii) ownership of fifty percent (50%) or more of the outstanding shares, or (iii) beneficial ownership of such entity.

**"Contribution"** means the code, documentation or other original works of authorship, including any modifications or additions to an existing work, that is intentionally submitted by You to Torqvoice for inclusion in, or documentation of, any of the products owned or managed by Torqvoice (the "Work"). For the purposes of this definition, "submitted" means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication sent to Torqvoice or its representatives, including but not limited to communication on electronic mailing lists, source code control systems, and issue tracking systems that are managed by, or on behalf of, Torqvoice for the purpose of discussing and improving the Work, but excluding communication that is conspicuously marked or otherwise designated in writing by You as "Not a Contribution."

Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied, including, without limitation, any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 8. Keeping Us Informed

It is Your responsibility to notify Torqvoice when any change is required to the list of designated persons authorized to submit Contributions on behalf of the Corporation, or to the contact person named below. Such notice is given by email to post@torqvoice.com from the contact person, naming this Agreement.
